recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-37467 unless a new tracker changes DocumentReference or CDA relatedDocument mapping semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-37467 was a Published/Persuasive R5 clarification asking to correct the DocumentReference CDA mapping by moving ClinicalDocument/relatedDocument semantics away from DocumentReference.context.related and mapping DocumentReference.relatesTo.code to ClinicalDocument/relatedDocument/typeCode and DocumentReference.relatesTo.target to ClinicalDocument/relatedDocument/parentDocument.
initial_application: Jira cites merge commit f2d7b07e50c2811a7ede6ce944f5cb33ecb12a98 for PR #2089. Its first-parent diff, from implementation commit 82d7ae7918d657b4dcd4534d3c244163aca850a9, added the requested CDA mappings to source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, so the StructureDefinition source is in current build scope. Composition.relatesTo still maps to DocumentReference.relatesTo and CDA .relatedDocument, supporting the same relatesTo semantics. SDWG minutes recorded agreement with the proposed resolution and moved ownership to OO; OO minutes recorded a Persuasive 4-0-0 vote. Zulip and additional Confluence FTS searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source maps DocumentReference.relatesTo.code to ClinicalDocument/relatedDocument/typeCode and DocumentReference.relatesTo.target to ClinicalDocument/relatedDocument/parentDocument, and no stale DocumentReference.context.related CDA mapping remains in current DocumentReference source.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Composition relatesTo work and its existing audit confirm ClinicalDocument/relatedDocument aligns with relatesTo semantics.
